component.name: Jottr
component.summary: Simple text and markdown editor mainly intended for writers, journalists and researchers

description.p: A simple, opinionated plain text and markdown editor designed for writers, journalists and researchers. Jottr has features like distraction-free writing, an integrated web-browser, customizable site-specific search from the context menu and smart auto-completion from saved snippets.
Added new icon themes: Google Materical Symbols
Fixed document recovery not working in Flatpak
Opening another Jottr window while one is running starts with an empty document
Zoom the editor with Ctrl+mouse wheel (Cmd+wheel on macOS) or Ctrl++
Jottr now automatically restores unsaved files after crash
Rename a tab by double-clicking it; saved files are renamed too
Right-click a tab to reveal the file in file manager
